 PR Newswire Wed, October 21, 2026 at 2:00 AM CDT 3 min read ezPaycheck 2026-2027 Bundle Integrates Direct IRS E-Filing to Help SMBs and Accountants Prevent Costly Tax Penalties 
 REDMOND, Wash., Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Halfpricesoft.com is highlighting its streamlined Form 941 e-file add-on feature for ezPaycheck payroll software ahead of the upcoming Q3 tax deadline. With the official deadline to submit IRS Form 941 for 2026 Q3 (July–September) fast approaching on Monday, November 2, 2026 (as October 31 falls on a Saturday), small businesses can leverage ezPaycheck to submit payroll taxes accurately and directly to the IRS, avoiding processing delays and costly late penalties. 
 Ensure the Q3 payroll taxes are compliant before November 2. Download a complimentary 30-day trial of ezPaycheck (no credit card required) or purchase the 2026-2027 ezPaycheck bundle for $378 (regularly $289). 
 Key Benefits of E-Filing Form 941 via ezPaycheck 
 Faster Direct Transmission: E-filed forms transmit straight to the IRS, ensuring faster receipt and processing compared to traditional mail. 
 On-Time Compliance: Businesses can e-file right up to the November 2 deadline while maintaining full IRS compliance, backed by Halfpricesoft.com support before, during, and after setup. 
 Fewer Errors & Rejections: Built-in verification reduces common manual input errors that trigger processing delays or fines. 
 Instant Confirmation: Users receive explicit IRS confirmation upon successful form receipt. 
 "With the e941 feature add-on in ezPaycheck, businesses have a tool to succeed, one form at a time." said  Dr. Ge, Founder of Halfpricesoft.com 
 Get Form 941 E-Filing Details & Instructions 
 Frequently Asked Questions 
 What happens if the filing deadline is missed? 
 Late filings can result in IRS penalties ranging from $50 to $290 per form, depending on how long the submission is delayed. 
 Can both Form 940 and Form 941 be e-filed through ezPaycheck? 
 ezPaycheck supports e-filing for both Form 940 (Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment Tax Return) and Form 941 (Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return) to maintain full compliance. 
 Easily calculate taxes, issue paychecks for employees and contractors, and generate all required reports and tax forms, including W-2, W-3, 940, 941, and 943. Because ezPaycheck runs locally, no internet connection is required to process payroll, keeping your data private and secure
